visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with breathtaking views of New Zealand's snow-capped Southern Alps, followed by a wide shot of a pedestrian bridge spanning a turquoise lake. A group of people is shown sitting on a green lawn in a park, enjoying a picnic under bright daylight. (2) The scene shifts to an airport terminal displaying Gate 76 for a flight to Auckland. The China Airlines logo is clearly visible on the flight information screen, indicating a travel context. (3) Two young men wave enthusiastically at the camera near the boarding gate, holding their passports and boarding passes. A shot of the China Airlines aircraft tail is shown through the terminal window under a clear blue sky. (4) Inside the aircraft, a woman in a white blouse smiles at the camera, followed by shots of a man in business class raising a glass. Split-screen montages show various travel moments, including looking out the cabin window and group selfies. (5) A close-up of a man's face wearing sunglasses reveals a reflection of the group taking a photo. The scene transitions to a parking lot where people are unloading suitcases from a car near green mountains. (6) A man stands by a serene lake with a weathered tree trunk in the foreground. Subsequent shots show the group cycling along a lakeside path and sitting peacefully by the water under a cloudy sky. (7) Energetic shots feature a young woman in a red sweatshirt and a man in a blue jacket cycling with excitement, pointing toward the scenery. They are surrounded by tall green trees and mountains. (8) A red helicopter is shown landing on a pristine snow-covered mountain peak. The group then poses together on the snow, dressed in winter gear, waving and smiling with the helicopter in the background. (9) The final shot returns to the pedestrian bridge from the beginning, where the entire group stands in a line, waving as the camera zooms out, with several lines of Chinese text overlaying the center of the frame.
